nodes.summary: A group $G$ has this property when, for every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Groups whose twisted classes of the identity are all subgroups

nodes.summary: The conjecture of Kourovka Problem 18.15 is false: there is a nontrivial group $G$ with trivial centre such that for every $a \in G$, with $\varphi$ the inner automorphism $\varphi(g) = aga^{-1}$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to Kourovka Problem 18.15

nodes.summary: Every nontrivial group $G$ with trivial centre has an element $a \in G$ such that, for the inner automorphism $\varphi(g) = aga^{-1}$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is not a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 18.15: an inner twisted class that is not a subgroup

nodes.summary: For a group $G$ and an automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the $\varphi$-twisted conjugacy class of the identity is the set $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\} \subseteq G$.
nodes.title: Twisted conjugacy class of the identity (Kourovka 18.14)

nodes.summary: For a group $G$ and an automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the $\varphi$-twisted conjugacy class of the identity is the set $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\} \subseteq G$.
nodes.title: Twisted conjugacy class of the identity (Kourovka 18.15)

nodes.summary: There is a finitely generated group $G$ that is not abelian although, for every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to the abelian assertion of Kourovka Problem 18.14

nodes.summary: Every finitely generated group $G$ in which, for every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$, is abelian.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 18.14, abelian assertion for finitely generated groups

nodes.summary: There is a group $G$ that is not nilpotent although, for every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to the nilpotency assertion of Kourovka Problem 18.14

nodes.summary: Every group $G$ in which, for every automorphism $\varphi$ of $G$, the twisted conjugacy class of the identity $[e]_\varphi = \{g^{-1}\varphi(g) : g \in G\}$ is a subgroup of $G$, is nilpotent.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 18.14, nilpotency assertion

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
